Core Capabilities

01

2,400 MT / Month Capacity

Modernized production line equipped with dual high-torque Muller Mixers, AMCL & Neptune extruders with heating arrangements.

02

Engineered Monolithics

Formulations tailored for blast furnaces from 40 m³ up to 4,000 m³ volume, resisting corrosive slag, mechanical wear, and extreme thermal shock.

03

Full R&D & In-House Lab

Complete testing suite including Cold Crushing Strength (CCS), Ring & Ball, Coal Tar Distillation, Muffle Furnaces, and Sand Rammers.

Flagship Products

Anhydrous Mudgun Mass

Resin and Tar+Resin bonded taphole clays engineered for quick setting, optimal plasticity, and zero molten metal penetration.

Anhydrous Trough Mass

Special resin-bonded runner mass resisting hot metal wash and chemical slag attack in blast furnace troughs.

Basic Ramming Mass (MR-RAM)

High MgO formulations (80%–86%) for electric arc furnaces (EAF), ladles, and induction furnace hot/cold launders.
